title: Layout model: blocks, pages and margins
text: bb_stack() places blocks top bottom; bb_cols() side side. Widths passed heights come back , nothing needs hand-set height. row, flexible children (plot, placeholder) stretch tallest fixed sibling. Tables placed side side can share row heights sync_rows = TRUE, dividers line .
code: row <- bb_cols(   bb_table(list(list("Total population", "45,696,159"),                 list("Surviving infants", "530,193")),            widths = c(2, 1), align = c("left", "right")),   bb_stack(bb_text("Notes", style = "subheading"),            bb_text("A second column with its own stack.", style = "note"),            gap = unit(4, "pt")),   widths = unit(c(4, 1), c("in", "null")),   # 4 in, then the rest   gap = 0.25 ) measure_block(row, width = 7.5) #> [1] 0.625inches

title: Layout model: blocks, pages and margins
text: page_template() holds page size, margins, header footer. bb_page() stacks blocks space . footer anchored bottom margin, lands place every page, however much content sits . page_layout() reports space without exporting. content outgrows body, export_pdf() warns overflow inches. bb_document() numbers pages dropping NULLs, optional page shifts every later “n / N” automatically:
code: template <- page_template(   margin_x = 0.5, margin_top = 0.3, margin_bottom = 0.3,   header = bb_running_header("Annual report", "{country}"),   footer = bb_page_footer("Organisation", "{page} / {pages}") )  page <- bb_page(   bb_section_header("Overview", refs = "[1]"),   row,   bb_box(bb_text("Flat grey note panel.", style = "note"), box_style_panel()),   template = template,   gap = c(0.08, 0.2),   data = list(country = "Argentina") )  page_layout(page)[c("available", "used", "free")] #> $available #> [1] 9.26375 #>  #> $used #> [1] 1.707813 #>  #> $free #> [1] 7.555938 optional_page <- NULL doc <- bb_document(page, optional_page, bb_page("Second page", template = template,                                                 data = list(country = "Argentina"))) f <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf") export_pdf(doc, f)

title: Build Infographic PDF Pages from Self-Sizing Blocks
text: Build infographic-style PDF pages R blocks size . bodybuildr handles annoying part report profile layout: deciding tall everything . piece page block knows height width gets. stack blocks, split columns, place page header footer stays pinned bottom margin. absolute coordinates, hand-tuned row heights, translated text runs longer just makes block taller.

title: Build Infographic PDF Pages from Self-Sizing Blocks
text: Self-sizing layout. bb_stack() bb_cols() pass widths collect heights . Plots stretch match neighbours. Real pages. page_template() gives margins, running header, footer anchored bottom {page} / {pages} numbering. export_pdf() writes whole document one PDF. Editorial tables. bb_table() draws rules-boxed tables rows grow wrapped text, per-column styles alignment, block cell (status icons, dots, images). Side--side tables can share row heights. Typography holds . text_style() supports weights 600 (installed font face), line height letter case; themes define every text role . Mixed content. Text (plain, Markdown, HTML), inline span()s underlined link()s, ggplot2 plots, images, grobs, legends, status marks, banners, section headers patterned placeholders.

title: Build Infographic PDF Pages from Self-Sizing Blocks

title: Build Infographic PDF Pages from Self-Sizing Blocks
code: library(bodybuildr)  template <- page_template(   margin_x = 0.5,   header   = bb_running_header("Immunization Profile", "{country}, 2025"),   footer   = bb_page_footer("Organisation, 2026", "{country} · {page} / {pages}") )  indicators <- bb_table(   list(     list("Total population",  "45,696,159"),     list("Surviving infants", "530,193"),     list("Skilled birth attendance", cell("No data", text_style(color = "faint")))   ),   widths = c(2, 1), align = c("left", "right"),   col_style = list(NULL, text_style(weight = 600)) )  page <- bb_page(   bb_section_header("General indicators", refs = "[1][2]"),   bb_cols(indicators, my_ggplot, gap = 0.3),      # the plot matches the table's height   bb_section_header("Notes"),   bb_box(bb_text("Values below <80% are flagged.", style = "note"), box_style_panel()),   template = template,   header   = bb_banner("Immunization Profile", "Argentina, 2025"),   gap      = c(0.08, 0.3, 0.08),   data     = list(country = "Argentina") )  export_pdf(bb_document(page, page_two), "profile.pdf")

title: Define a theme — bb_theme
text: **Colours.** Every colour argument bodybuildr accepts either R colour name theme colour, example `"muted"` `"rule_light"`. Defaults: `primary`, `accent`, `ink`, `text2`, `muted`, `faint`, `rule_strong`, `rule_light`, `rule_faint`, `panel`, `panel_alt`, `on_primary`, `on_primary_muted`. Add names freely. **Text roles.** Components take `style = NULL` fall back role: `body`, `table_body`, `note`, `small`, `subheading`, `section`, `refs`, `title`, `subtitle`, `running`, `running_right`, `table_header`, `legend`, `footer`, `status_label`, `placeholder`. Pass role name `style` anywhere (`bb_text(x, style = "note")`), override role `text`, add new roles. Default sizes follow 12px = 9pt body scale; `base_size` scales .

what: bodybuildr: infographic pages built from blocks — bodybuildr-package
title: bodybuildr: infographic pages built from blocks — bodybuildr-package
text: bodybuildr lays PDF pages trees *blocks*. block knows tall given width draw top-left corner space given. Blocks compose vertically [bb_stack()] horizontally [bb_cols()], [bb_page()] places header footer pinned bottom margin. [export_pdf()] writes one many pages single PDF.

title: bodybuildr: infographic pages built from blocks — bodybuildr-package
text: Spacing comes three separate bands, never mixed: 1. **Page margins** [page_template()]. Blocks marked `full_bleed`    escape side margins. 2. **Layout gaps**: `gap` [bb_stack()] [bb_cols()]. 3. **Box spacing**: padding margin [bb_box()] / [box_style()]. Geometry accepts `grid::unit` objects plain numbers, read inches. Colours accept R colour name theme colour (see [bb_theme()]).

title: Define a text style — text_style
text: text style lists properties changes. Anything left `NULL` inherited `base` (theme role name another text style), role component uses default. `text_style(weight = 600)` passed [bb_text()] means "body text, semibold", style passed table header style means "table header, semibold".

title: Define a text style — text_style
text: base theme role name (e.g. `"note"`) another `text_style()` inherit . size Font size points. weight Font weight, numeric (100-900) name (`"regular"`, `"semibold"`, `"bold"`, ...). color Text colour: R colour theme colour name. family Font family. italic `TRUE` italic. lineheight Line height multiple font size. case Letter case applied plain text: `"none"`, `"upper"`, `"lower"` `"title"`.

title: Define a text style — text_style
text: **Weights.** `weight` takes number (100-900) name `"semibold"`. 400 700 use family's regular bold faces. weights looked systemfonts: face weight installed (example "Source Sans 3 Semibold"), family name used, `cairo_pdf()` resolves fontconfig. Otherwise bodybuildr falls back bold (600 ) regular, one-time message.
